physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Abell 1689 is recorded: it is an extended cluster of galaxies, and its package frames it at 363,337 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at the cluster's distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: Sadibekova et al. (2024), MCXC-II, A&A 688 A187; CDS J/A+A/688/A187, byte columns defined by https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/ReadMe (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/mcxcii.dat.gz); catalogue reference mcxc-ii:MCXC J1311.5-0120
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the catalogued redshift z = 0.1832 (MCXC-II row MCXC J1311.5-0120, redshift reference 1999ApJS..125...35S) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 776055140.5590516 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the cluster of galaxies is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the catalogued redshift z = 0.1832: the redshift written as a velocity, not a motion through space. Redshift reference 1999ApJS..125...35S, transcribed from MCXC-II (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1999ApJS..125...35S).
